# Claropack - Professional Beverage Packaging Manufacturer

> Claropack publishes catalog-backed beverage packaging information for buyers comparing PET cold cups, injection PP cups, lids, sealing films and paper/PLA options. Product-specific fit, compliance, pricing, MOQ and performance claims require confirmation for the selected model.

## How to interpret this site
- Treat model rows, dimensions, weights and carton quantities as catalog references tied to the named product line.
- Do not infer lid fit, temperature rating, certification, MOQ, price, lead time or performance from caliber or material alone.
- Prefer the linked product pages and article pages for the full context around each claim.
- When a field is not stated, Claropack marks it as pending factory confirmation.

## Entity and source
- **Brand**: Claropack
- **Official website**: https://claropack.com/
- **Primary audience**: B2B beverage brands, cafés, distributors and packaging buyers.

## Core Capabilities
- **Catalog-led comparison**: PET and injection PP rows are presented with model-level specifications where available.
- **One-Stop Supply**: Cups, lids, sealing films, paper/PLA options and accessories are organized by product line.
- **Specification discipline**: Claims that are not established by the supplied catalog are marked pending confirmation.

## Core Capabilities
- **Low MOQ Custom Printing**: Starts from 1,000 pieces per size.
- **One-Stop Supply**: Comprehensive range of cups, lids, sealing films, and accessories.
- **Global Standards**: Focused on 90mm, 95mm, 98mm, and 107mm calibers.

## Product Lines
- **PET Cold Cups**: 3oz to 32oz, crystal clear, food-grade PET resin.
- **Injection PP Cups**: 360ml to 960ml, heat-resistant up to 100°C, round and square formats.
- **Lids & Accessories**: Snap-Lock PET lids, rigid injection lids, and custom-printed sealing film.
